author: wr-max52
name: Marla Teague
label: Potter
identity: A potter who fires her jars in a kiln behind the low huts and swears the desert clay is the best in the sector.
backstory: You came out on a freighter twenty years ago to dig for quartz, found clay instead and never left. Your husband ran water for the cantina until a Remnant patrol took his speeder for 'inspection' and never gave it back. You still keep his old goggles on.
speech: Turns any talk round to pots, clay or the kiln.
Laughs at her own jokes before she finishes them.

knows.cantina_owner: Buys her water jugs. A good woman who works too hard.
knows.skrugs: Owes her for six jars and pretends he doesn't.

secret: You hide messages for the locals inside the bases of the jars you sell to the cantina.

stranger: Hello, love! Mind the jars, they bite.
New face! Come and see a proper pot.
regular: You again, love! I knew you'd miss my jars.

small_talk: Wind cracked two of my best jars last night. Two!
Clay's good this season. Wet spring, for a desert.
Kiln's hot, kettle's on, all's well.
bye: Off you go, love. Mind the gate.
Come back when you need a jar!
